clues.text: This coaster reaches a modest top speed of 22 mph, stands just 22 feet tall, and features zero inversions.
Built entirely in-house by park staff, this classic attraction opened to guests in 1978.
You will find this attraction tucked away in the mountain setting of a famous theme park in Tennessee.
Operating at Dollywood as an enclosed dark ride roller coaster, this attraction was closely modeled after Fire In The Hole at Silver Dollar City.
The attraction's two-word name evokes an intensely burning, fiery wrath or rage.

evidence.quote: '''Blazing Fury''' is an [[enclosed]] [[dark ride]] [[roller coaster]] located at [[Dollywood]] in Pigeon Forge, Tennessee, USA.
The ride is based on [[Fire In The Hole (1972)|Fire In The Hole]] at [[Silver Dollar City]].
